method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Form A p2 has 2 inked rows, $50.00 + $50.00 = $100.00, exactly the cover line 1 TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT cell. It does NOT equal the CUMULATIVE cell ($4,500.00), so this side is on the PERIOD scope - a different scope from the cumulative figure the module publishes, which is honest and expected here. The cover's own identity holds: 4,400.00 + 100.00 = 4,500.00. Reconciled against line 1 only; line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate, $89.00 cumulative, 0 this period) is never itemized. The Carr form prints no schedule total (schedule_total null).

expenditures.detail: Form B p3 has 4 inked rows: 380.00 + 580.00 + 415.00 + 590.00 = 1,965.00, exactly the cover line 3 TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT cell; the CUMULATIVE cell is 16,037.69, so this side is PERIOD scope. The cover identity holds: 14,072.69 + 1,965.00 = 16,037.69, and that identity is what settled the one ambiguous glyph (row 1, see escalation_note).

gates.page_subtotal: Carr 5-5-PG prints no schedule or page subtotal; the cover is the only anchor. p2 rows 100.00 = cover line1 THIS 100.00 (gates). p3 rows 1965.00 = cover line3 THIS 1,965.00 (gates). Cover cross-check: both LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE identities close on lines 1, 2 and 3.
gates.row_count: Counted ink against the ruled grid on the 200 dpi renders: p2 first 2 writing lines inked, 2 rows emitted; p3 first 4 writing lines inked, 4 rows emitted. The single-cell geometry proof (first row, last row, one pitch past the last row) independently confirms no dropped or duplicated line on either page.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: row1 box (x84%,y10.30%,w14%,h2%) renders '$50.00'; row2 box (y12.30%) renders '$50. 00'; control one pitch below (y14.40%) renders EMPTY. p3: row1 box (y10.30%) renders '$380.00'; row4 box (y16.50%) renders '$590.00'; control one pitch below (y18.60%) renders EMPTY.
gates.balance_chain: Does NOT close, and the non-closure is the filer's own. Cover line 4 'Balance at the end of this reporting period' is a slashed-zero glyph in all three columns (LAST, THIS, CUMULATIVE), while the cumulative money lines are contributions 4,500.00 + 89.00 = 4,589.00 against expenses 16,037.69, i.e. 4,589.00 - 16,037.69 = -11,448.69. The stated zero is retained verbatim and NOT recomputed. The three money lines themselves each satisfy LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE exactly. This chunk holds no earlier Pitcher filing, so the cross-filing chain test could not be run; note that the cover's own LAST-REPORT column ($4,400.00 / $89.00 / $14,072.69) is the hook for it.

escalation_note: 600 dpi strip crops of Form A rows, Form B rows 1-4 and the cover totals block; 900 dpi crops of the Form B vendor column and the Form B row-1 amount cell; a 1200 dpi crop of the same cell; six geometry-proof cell crops. THE ONE REAL AMBIGUITY: Form B row 1's amount is an over-written glyph - a '3' followed by what is either an '8' drawn as two stacked ovals or a '0' with a second oval written under it, then '0. 00'. At 900 and 1200 dpi the glyph stays bistable between $380.00 and $300.00. RESOLVED BY ARITHMETIC, not by resolution, per the Rhodes rule: 380 + 580 + 415 + 590 = 1,965.00 = the printed cover line-3 THIS cell, and 14,072.69 + 1,965.00 = 16,037.69 = the printed CUMULATIVE cell; under 300 the side would miss by 80.00 and both printed identities would break. Recorded as 380.00 with the glyph described in the row note.

NOTE ON FORM A: both itemized contributions are exactly $50.00, which is NOT 'more than $50.00' as line 1 requires - the filer itemized them anyway and carried them in the line-1 column ($100.00 this period). Transcribed as the filer wrote them; no reclassification made. Contributor addresses are given as city+state only on the form ('Lewiston, Utah'), so nothing had to be discarded there.
